content.title: ‘Nearly the size of a football field’: Do you know how tall the NASA Artemis II moon rocket is?
content.text: By accepting cookies, you agree to the storing of cookies on your device to enhance site navigation, analyze site usage, and assist in our marketing efforts.NASA’s Artemis II mission will use the massive Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1 rocket to send four astronauts around the Moon.
